europe_now.title: Spanish Transport Minister Resigns Over Train Crash
europe_now.summary: Spain's transport minister has resigned following a deadly train accident that prompted significant political fallout. The departure underscores immediate governmental accountability regarding public transport safety.

sources.headline: Spain’s transport minister resigns after deadly train crash
Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash

europe_now.title: Bomb Threats Target Multiple European Flights
europe_now.summary: Authorities reported that seven flights across Europe were subjected to suspected bomb threats, causing widespread concern and operational disruptions. Security protocols were activated as investigations into the coordinated threats continue.

sources.headline: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats

top_stories.title: US Midterm Elections and Democratic Gains
top_stories.summary: Democrats secured major victories in the United States midterm elections, taking control of both the House and Senate. The shift in congressional power marks a significant political setback for President Trump's legislative agenda.

top_stories.title: EU Approach to Ukraine Accession
top_stories.summary: The European Union has advised Ukraine to accelerate its internal reforms while outlining a more cautious framework for future membership. This policy stance establishes a deliberate and structured timeline for the country's integration process.
